options {
	directory "/var/named";
	listen-on port 53 {
		127.0.0.1/32;
	};
	forwarders {
		192.168.2.1;
		8.8.8.8;
	};
	forward first;
	allow-query {
		localhost;
	};
};
zone "example.local" IN {
	type master;
	file "example.local.zone";
	allow-update {
		none;
	};
	allow-transfer {
		none;
	};
};
zone "10.168.192.in-addr.arpa" IN {
	type master;
	file "10.168.192.in-addr.arpa.zone";
};
zone "secondary.local" IN {
	type slave;
	file "slaves/secondary.local.zone";
	masters {
		192.168.2.50;
	};
};
zone "corp.partner.example" IN {
	type forward;
	forward only;
	forwarders {
		10.9.8.7;
		10.9.8.8;
	};
};
zone "signed.local" IN {
	type master;
	file "signed.local.zone";
	inline-signing yes;
	auto-dnssec maintain;
};
zone "dynamic.local" IN {
	type master;
	file "dynamic.local.zone";
	allow-update {
		key "ddns-key";
	};
};
zone "localhost" IN {
	type master;
	file "named.localhost";
};
zone "1.0.0.127.in-addr.arpa" IN {
	type master;
	file "named.loopback";
};
zone "." IN {
	type hint;
	file "named.ca";
};
view "internal" {
	zone "split.local" IN {
		type master;
		file "split.local.internal.zone";
	};
};
